json.rationale: This is a crossroads with no sign, light or marking regulating priority. Both roads are paved. The only other vehicle is a car approaching from the left, and the rule is to yield (ceda el paso) only to vehicles approaching from the right, so there is nobody to give way to.
json.temptingWrongAnswer: Yield to the car coming from the left
json.whyWrong: The excerpt only requires yielding to vehicles approaching from the right, not from the left. The car from the left must yield to you.
